title: Visualizing the World Model in an Agent's Value Function
abstract: arXiv:2610.14186v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Could model-free reinforcement learning algorithms actually be learning a model of the environment? In this work, we apply counterfactual interventions which hold everything about a state fixed, besides a targeted change, to explore if the value function of a Proximal Policy Optimization agent forms a world model of the Crafter environment. Despite only being trained to optimize reward, we discover that the value function learns concepts such as the rules governing when a diamond is collectible, water and food having an impact on health, heuristics regarding inventory, and more. Finally, we discuss the safety implications of our visualizations and some shortcomings of current reinforcement learning agents that will prevent us from building truly advanced machine intelligence.

translated_title: 可视化智能体价值函数中的世界模型
translated_abstract: 无模型强化学习算法是否实际上在学习环境模型？在本工作中，我们应用反事实干预方法——保持状态中除目标变化之外的所有要素不变——来探究近端策略优化（PPO）智能体的价值函数是否形成了Crafter环境的世界模型。尽管仅被训练用于优化奖励，我们发现价值函数学会了诸如钻石何时可被收集的规则、水和食物对健康的影响、关于物品库存的启发式知识等概念。最后，我们讨论了这些可视化的安全意义，以及当前强化学习智能体的一些缺陷，这些缺陷将阻碍我们构建真正先进的机器智能。
tldr: 研究通过反事实干预可视化发现，无模型强化学习（PPO）智能体的价值函数在仅以优化奖励为目标的训练中，隐式地学到了环境的世界模型，包括游戏规则、资源对健康的影响等概念。
en_tdlr: This work demonstrates through counterfactual interventions that the value function of a model-free PPO agent implicitly learns a world model of the environment—including game rules and resource-health relationships—despite being trained solely to optimize reward.
